9	/-!
10	# The glued clauses on a straddling cover: (c2)/(c3)/(c4) REDUCE to (c1)
11	
12	The corrected cert-collapse claim (roadmap `...certificate.cert-collapse`, as amended after
13	the I-0340 refutation), carried out on the widened cover.
14	
15	## What was refuted and what survives
16	
17	The refuted claim was that (c2)/(c3)/(c4) are FREE for a swallow-or-miss adaptation.  They are
18	not, and `DivisorFamilyAffCollapse.lean` kernel-checks why: `toOvlLeft i i = toOvlRight i i`
19	by `rfl`, so every diagonal component of `deltaLeft - deltaRight` vanishes for EVERY
20	adaptation, and the diagonal factor always survives in the cokernel.  Clause (c4) therefore
21	always implies flatness of the diagonal overlap colengths — no structural observation about
22	which pieces meet the support can remove that.
23	
24	What survives is the REDUCTION the amended node states: on a cover with a straddling piece,
25	(c2)/(c3)/(c4) follow from (c1)-projectivity alone.  This file proves it.
26	
27	## The mechanism, and it is sharper than the node's account
28	
29	With a straddling piece `j₀`, every OTHER piece misses the support, so
30	`subsingleton_ovlColength_of_disjoint` kills every overlap colength that involves an index
31	`≠ j₀` — in particular every OFF-DIAGONAL one, since a pair `(i, j)` with `i ≠ j` has at least
32	one entry `≠ j₀`.  Combined with the vanishing diagonal, `deltaLeft - deltaRight` is the ZERO
33	map (`deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy`).  Hence:
34	
35	* `gluedSubmodule = ⊤`, so `Glued ≃ chartProd` — (c2) becomes a statement about the product of
36	  the piece colengths, of which all but one are subsingleton;
37	* `chartProd ⧸ gluedSubmodule` is subsingleton, so (c3) is free — and this IS free, with no
38	  input, which is the one part of the original claim that was right;
39	* `range (deltaLeft - deltaRight) = ⊥`, so the (c4) cokernel is `ovlProd` itself, whose
40	  factors are the overlap colengths: all subsingleton except `ovlColength j₀ j₀`.  So (c4)
41	  reduces to flatness of THAT ONE module — exactly the residue the refutation predicted, now
42	  isolated to a single index instead of a whole cover.
43	
44	## Main declarations
45	
46	* `AffAdaptation.deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy` — the difference arrow vanishes identically.
47	* `AffAdaptation.gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy` — the equalizer is everything.
48	* `AffAdaptation.gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy` — hence `Glued ≃ₗ chartProd`.
49	* `AffAdaptation.flat_coker_incl_of_swallowedBy` — clause (c3), unconditionally free.
50	* `AffAdaptation.flat_coker_diff_of_swallowedBy` — clause (c4) from flatness of the single
51	  diagonal overlap colength at the straddling piece.
52	-/

86	  · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hmiss j hj)) hsupp hz.2
